-- Free-text notes a user writes about something in the app. A note is generic: it points at a
-- target by type + id (e.g. a 'project') so the same table can carry notes for other kinds later.

CREATE TABLE notes (
    id          BIGINT                   GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    target_type VARCHAR(32)              NOT NULL,
    target_id   BIGINT                   NOT NULL,
    text        VARCHAR(4000)            NOT NULL,
    at          TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_notes_target ON notes (target_type, target_id);

The test passes. Let me summarize the full-stack change I made.

The request — "add notes to invoices too, not just jobs" — reused the existing generic `notes` infrastructure. No schema migration was needed: the `notes` table already keys on `(target_type, target_id)`, and the `/__test__/seed` path already inserts invoice-targeted notes.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST on Spring Boot):
- `NoteService` — added `listForInvoice` / `addToInvoice`, mirroring the project methods but with `target_type = 'invoice'`.
- New logic classes `InvoiceNotesLogic` and `AddInvoiceNoteLogic` (reusing the existing `NewNote` body and `NoteView` response).
- New endpoint YAMLs `rest/api/invoices/{invoiceId}/notes.GET.yml` and `.POST.yml`.
- `TestSupportController` — the seed's note `at` parser now also accepts a plain date (the spec seeds `at: '2026-02-01'`), treating it as start-of-day UTC; full ISO offset timestamps still work.

**Front-end** (React):
- New `InvoiceNotes.tsx` feature component (a `data-testid="invoice-notes"` section reusing the shared `note-form-*` / `note-row-*` / `note-text` anchors), composed into the invoice detail view in `InvoiceLineItems.tsx`.
- `ProjectDetail.tsx` now early-returns the invoice detail view when an invoice is open, so the project's own Notes panel no longer co-renders with the invoice's (which had produced duplicate `note-form-text` anchors).

All changes are additive and local — no renamed/removed `data-testid`s, no edits to pinned scaffolding.
